Experience the enchanting beauty of Raga Malkauns in this rare excerpt from an all-night concert featuring the Santoor maestro Pandit Shivkumar Sharma, accompanied by the late Tabla virtuoso Ustad Shafaat Ahmad Khan.
Recorded at London's iconic Queen Elizabeth Hall in June 1993, this unreleased archival footage captures the essence of Indian classical music.
Pandit Shivkumar Sharma & Ustad Shafaat Ahmad Khan | Raga Malkauns | Live Concert 1993
